messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف معلومات غير موجودة، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON فقط وفق الشكل: {"book_code":"APMO","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"text_ar":"..."}]}. أخرج وحدة واحدة لكل مدخل بالترتيب. إذا كان مرجع المصدر مجمّعاً مثل 1,2 فترجم نصه مرة واحدة واجعل verse أول رقم فقط، ولا تقسّمه إلى وحدتين.

{"book_code":"APMO","units":[{"chapter":14,"text":"Thus spake the angel and departed from them. And Seth and Eve came to the hut where Adam was laid. And Adam saith to Eve: 'Eve, what","source_ref":"14:1"},{"chapter":14,"text":"hast thou wrought in us? Thou hast brought upon us great wrath which is death, [lording it over all our race].' And he saith to her, 'Call all","source_ref":"14:2"},{"chapter":14,"text":"our children and our children's children and tell them the manner of our transgression.'","source_ref":"14:3"},{"chapter":15,"text":"Then saith Eve to them: 'Hear all my children and children's children and I will relate to you","source_ref":"15:1"},{"chapter":15,"text":"how the enemy deceived us. It befell that we were guarding paradise, each of us the portion","source_ref":"15:2"}]}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return one item per input unit, in input order, using the first printed number when a source label is grouped: 14:1, 14:2, 14:3, 15:1, 15:2.
